summary: Tested the new RAR AutoPass module (backend and UI) and ran the P0 regression for storno, supplier returns, inbox PDF and multi-VAT UBL. P0 regression: 20 passed, 1 skipped (test_storno_returns.py). RAR backend: 8 of 10 tests pass. These work: 401 without login; 403 for mecanic; 400 for an invalid environment and 422 for an empty authorization code; the token is never in the PUT/GET responses and is stored encrypted; saving without a token keeps the stored token; test-connection gives a controlled 409 and writes a log; the outbox keeps exactly one idempotent entry across invoice issue and work-order close (trigger_events = invoice_issued + work_order_closed), with state blocked, the requirements listed, odometer value and timestamp, odometer_image_url null, invoice number and operations summary. CRITICAL BUG: the VIN and plate in the payload are always empty. UI desktop: the sidebar link, /rar-autopass, saving, Test/Producție switch, token field cleared with a 'salvat criptat' placeholder, no token leak in any network response, 409 toast on test connection, outbox table — all work. Mobile 390px: the RAR page overflows horizontally (scrollWidth 970). No JS errors.

critical.issue: The vehicle lookup uses db.vehicles.find_one({'_id': invoice.get('vehicle_id')}) with a STRING id, but vehicles._id is an ObjectId. The vehicle is never found, so payload.vehicle.vin and plate_number are always '' and every entry gets 'VIN valid cu 17 caractere' in its blocked requirements. The invoice document has no vehicle_id field at all (only a 'vehicle' display string). Confirmed on real data: CL-2026-00070 / SRV000077 has vehicle VIN HKL4E116TAHUYHV4L, but its outbox payload has vin=''. Fix: use oid(work_order['vehicle_id']).

minor.issue: Uses closed_at or invoiced_at or now(), and ignores work_order.finished_at (the real completion date). At invoice time it takes today's date, because the WO passed in is the pre-update copy without invoiced_at. After closing, it changes to the closing date, so the completion date differs between the two triggers.
Always adds 'contract API oficial' to the missing list, even when api_contract_configured would be true. This is acceptable for now because transport is intentionally inactive.
Runs after the invoice is inserted and is not wrapped in try/except. Any exception would return a 500 even though the invoice was already created and stock consumed.
Logging in as contabil@ and receptie@ with Demo2026! returns 'Email sau parolă incorectă'. Either the passwords differ or the doc is outdated. mecanic@ works.

ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal page overflow: document scrollWidth is 970 at a 390 viewport, so the panels are cut off on the right. Likely cause: the outbox table has min-w-[920px] and the grid children have no min-w-0, so the grid column grows past the viewport (overflow-x-auto does not take effect).

issues: Uses native <select> for supplier, NIR and product, and a native date input (browser default picker) instead of shadcn Select / Calendar
The qty inputs sit in a horizontally scrolling table (560px inside 340px), so on mobile they are off-screen until the user scrolls sideways
An empty selection shows 'Total stornare: -0,00 RON' (negative zero)
scrollWidth 542 at 390px, a small horizontal overflow (pre-existing)

action_items: Fix the vehicle lookup in rar_autopass.queue_submission: db.vehicles.find_one({'_id': oid(work_order['vehicle_id'])})
Use work_order.finished_at for completion_date and keep it stable across triggers
Fix the RAR page mobile overflow (add min-w-0 on the grid/Panel or wrap the table so overflow-x-auto works)
Wrap the queue_submission calls in try/except with logging so an RAR outbox error cannot break invoicing or closing
Optional: shadcn Select/Calendar in SupplierReturnDialog; avoid -0,00 in the storno total; verify the contabil/receptie credentials in test_credentials.md

The work-order status endpoint is POST /api/work-orders/{id}/status. UI fixture for storno/return dialogs: python /app/backend/tests/storno_fixtures.py setup|teardown.
rca of the issue: VIN empty: rar_autopass.queue_submission does find_one({'_id': invoice.get('vehicle_id')}) (the invoice has no vehicle_id, so the value is None) and then find_one({'_id': work_order['vehicle_id']}), a string compared against an ObjectId _id. Neither matches, so vehicle is None, vin='' and plate=''. Reproduce: issue a fiscal invoice for any finalized WO and inspect db.rar_autopass_outbox payload.vehicle. Mitigation: use core.oid() on the id.
